description: Pedestrians and Cyclists in Road Traffic: Trajectories, 3D Poses and Semantic Maps is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Viktor Kress, Stefan Zernetsch (University of Applied Sciences Aschaffenburg). The dataset consists of more than 2300 trajectories of pedestrians and 1000 trajectories of cyclists recorded by a research vehicle of the University of Applied Sciences Aschaffenburg (Kooperative Automatisierte Verkehrssysteme) in urban traffic. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
